latent_mapping: generated_latent_base + 10000*initial_family + batch_index; same seed across temperatures and trained models. Within-batch path index defines latent identity. Batch partition is frozen, not claimed invariant to repartitioning.
scope: Frozen-model inference only,128 paths per condition and initial for each of3 trained seeds. No real future trajectory is loaded. No model selection, automatic retries or analysis before complete batch.
